topics.rikers:
## Rikers

The **Rikers** are prisoners who took the opportunity to escape prison during the epidemic outbreak. They took advantage of the prison staff who were sick and didn't show up to work. Once on the mainland, their goal is to wreak as much havoc into society.
topics.hyenas:
## Hyenas

A loosely organized gang of opportunistic raiders that prey on struggling civilian encampments through violence and intimidation. These hedonistic scavengers take everything they can steal and destroy everything else to deprive their enemies of valuable resources. The **Hyenas** are led by a council of the strongest pack leaders.
topics.outcasts:
## Outcasts

The **Outcasts** are hell-bent on revenge against society because they were placed in a forced quarantine that was poorly run and killed many. Their leader, Emeline Shaw, believes everyone is complicit and urges her followers to punish the guilty by spreading sickness and murdering indiscriminately.
topics.cleaners:
## Cleaners

The **Cleaners** are a group of former firefighters who have been infected with the virus. They are highly trained and organized, and they use their knowledge of fire to their advantage. They are known for their brutal tactics and their willingness to kill anyone who gets in their way.
topics.black_tusk:
## Black Tusk

A secretive private military organization that operates on an unknown agenda. They are disciplined and highly organized, and their unparalleled and advanced equipment make them the biggest threat JTF & The Division has ever faced.
topics.lmb:
## Last Man Battalion (LMB)

The Last Man Battalion (LMB) is a Private Military Company (PMC) that was originally contracted to protect the city during the outbreak. However, they have since become a rogue faction, using their military training and equipment to take control of the city and eliminate anyone who stands in their way.
topics.rogue:
## Rogue Agents

**Rogue Agents** are former Division agents who have gone rogue and are now working against the Division. They are highly trained and dangerous, and they will stop at nothing to achieve their goals.
topics.hunters:
## Hunters

**Hunters** are a mysterious faction whose goal appears to be just killing JTF & Division Agents.
topics.prosec:
## Prosec International

**Prosec International**, a clandestine Private Military Company (PMC), operates in the shadows with inscrutable motives, targeting hostile factions and covert organizations while concealing the darker aspects of their operations behind a veil of secrecy. Their enigmatic presence looms large in the world of global power dynamics, with their true agenda known only to those who navigate the corridors of shadow and intrigue.
topics.shd:
## Strategic Homeland Division (SHD)

The **Strategic Homeland Division (SHD)**, commonly referred to as the Division, is a secretive government organization tasked with responding to catastrophic events and threats to national security. Agents of the Division are highly trained operatives equipped with advanced technology and resources to combat emerging threats, including rogue factions, criminal organizations, and global crises. The Division operates under a strict code of conduct and is dedicated to protecting the nation from both internal and external dangers.
topics.darkzone:
## Dark Zone

The **Dark Zone** is a quarantined area in Manhattan that has been overrun by hostile factions and infected individuals. It is a lawless zone where players can engage in PvP combat, loot valuable resources, and face off against dangerous enemies. The Dark Zone is a high-risk, high-reward area that tests the skills and strategies of Division agents.
topics.cera:
## Civilian Emergency Response Agency (CERA)

The **Civilian Emergency Response Agency (CERA)** is a government organization responsible for coordinating emergency response efforts during crises. CERA works closely with local authorities, first responders, and other agencies to provide aid, resources, and support to affected communities. Their mission is to ensure the safety and well-being of civilians during emergencies, including natural disasters, pandemics, and other catastrophic events.
topics.nspd:
## National Security and Protection Division (NSPD)

The **National Security and Protection Division (NSPD)** is a specialized government agency tasked with safeguarding national security interests and protecting critical infrastructure. NSPD operates in coordination with other federal agencies to prevent and respond to threats, including terrorism, cyberattacks, and other security challenges. Their mission is to protect the nation and its citizens from emerging threats.
topics.nspd51:
## National Security and Protection Division (NSPD) - Unit 51

The **National Security and Protection Division (NSPD) - Unit 51** is a specialized unit within the NSPD that focuses on advanced threat detection, intelligence gathering, and rapid response to high-risk situations. Unit 51 operates with a high level of secrecy and is equipped with cutting-edge technology and resources to address emerging threats to national security. Their mission is to protect the nation from both domestic and international threats through proactive measures and strategic interventions.
topics.jtf:
## Joint Task Force (JTF)

The **Joint Task Force (JTF)** is a collaborative military and law enforcement organization that brings together personnel from various agencies to respond to crises and maintain order during emergencies. The JTF operates under a unified command structure, coordinating efforts to address threats, provide security, and support civilian populations in times of need. Their mission is to ensure the safety and stability of affected areas through coordinated operations and strategic planning.
topics.answer:
## The ANSWER Protocol

The **ANSWER Protocol** is a specialized process to simplify mobilization and deployment of assets in response toa major crisis. Taugh to all agents, this system underpins field operations and lets SHD operators adapt to most situations they encounter.
topics.calo:
## Cognitive Assistant that Learns and Organizes (CALO)

The **Cognitive Assistant that Learns and Organizes (CALO)** project is an artificial intelligence developed by the Pentagon to support operators in the field.
topics.isac:
## Intelligent System Analytic Computer (ISAC)

The **Intelligent System Analytic Computer (ISAC)** is a highly advanced artificial intelligence (AI) entity available to all active Division agents equipped with an SHD Tech transceiver. Accessible via the SHD Network, ISAC serves as the critical backbone of all Division activities. This sophisticated AI is the latest incarnation of the original CALO project.
topics.shdnetwork:
## SHD Network

The **SHD Network** is a system used by the SHD to assist its personnel throughout different sectors in the organization. Long before the outbreak, several infrastructures had been set up throughout the entire country and created a network which will seamlessly connect all Division personnel to ISAC and its utilities.

Inside the Decontamination Zones, also known as the Dark Zones, the SHD Network is heavily disrupted. This caused the Division agents who entered the zones to have only proximity comms with other agents nearby.
topics.gobag:
## Go-Bag

A **Go-Bag** is a light backpack containing everything needed to operate independently for 72 hours. This mission bag is an essential tool that agents must keep with them at all times. Collected upon activation, it contains most of the agent's gear, as well as resources useful to the squad, their support staff, and any civilians they may encounter during the operation.
topics.smartwatch:
## Smartwatch

Every agent wears a **SmartWatch** on their wrist. Once connected to the network by the Go-Bag's secure transmitter, this mobile terminal grants secure access to most of the tools and devices used during a mission.
topics.scantek:
## ScanTek Lenses

Most agents use **ScanTek eye lenses** during missions; flexible, transpparent shields in real-time contact with ISAC. The lenses are embedded with receivers that capture and transmit real-time information, including mission conditions and alerts from the network, command, or endangered squads.
topics.echo:
## Evidence Correlation Holographic Overlay (ECHO) Device

The **Evidence Correlation Holographic Overlay (ECHO)** or **ECHO Device** is a groundbreaking analysis tool recently developed by the Division's R&D department. When used with ISAC, ECHO correlates disparate bits of data it finds in the field to analyze and reconstruct past events. Using the agents' readings and the SmartWatch's native analysis tools, the device collects information from nearby surveillance systems like cameras and drones, as well as from the scene itself. Once the data is compiled, ECHO processes it to generate an accurate depiction of events, which is then projected onto the scene as a 3D hologram.
